scenario: Regex flags `i`, `m`, `s` are defined in v1 per LREG.5.1 / LREG.5.2. Pin: `e.msg ~ /error/i`, the case-insensitive flag, compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES. The flag at runtime is logical/RLOW.5.2.2_alpha_regex_flags's.
rules_ds:
schema Log scope logical:
    msg: String key

rule find_error:
    Log e where e.msg ~ /error/i
->
    log info "error found"
